title: A person's deliberate block on u9h was silently dropped by the run's own merge, which keeps dispatching the attempts the block exists to stop (sixth counterexample)
body: origin/main at 1b725f49 records the person adding 37i to u9h.blocked_by, yet this dispatch (attempt 27) received a run branch whose u9h.blocked_by has 14 entries and no 37i. The run's merge 96977e99 drops the block, so the dispatcher cannot see it and keeps spending go6 interventions the block exists to stop — six consecutive counterexamples now (attempts 22-27), matching previously drafted findings a2d01075, 221dfd7e, 86596dbe, and 9aca70a0, all still untriaged. The dispatcher must consult origin/main for blocks, or the merge must stop dropping blocked_by entries.
